rules.infinite_in_degree: X_1(5,10) has only finitely many points of absolute degree 8
rules.sporadic: finitely many points of each absolute degree <= 8 on X_1(5,10)
rules.isolated: finitely many points of absolute degree 8 on X_1(5,10), so the point lies in no positive-dimensional family

points.discovered_by: P. L. Clark, P. Corn, A. Rice, J. Stankewicz
points.reference: P. L. Clark, P. Corn, A. Rice, J. Stankewicz, Computation on elliptic curves with complex multiplication, LMS J. Comput. Math. 17 (2014), 509-535, Section 4.8; explicit points: F. Najman, Torsion of elliptic curves over number fields of degree 6, 7, 8 and 9 (2026), https://hexagonmath.org/2611.00073v2, Proposition 13.4.
